reviews.review:
I am a bad gamer. It's a good game but the spike in difficulty on level 2-4 is harsh. That crap is hard!

The price is way to high though. I'm happy to support your efforts, but it's not a nearly $20 game.
reviews.developer_response:
I'm so sorry you're stuck at the very beginning of the game!
I want to help you, so I posted a video of the first few minutes of the game on the SQUARE PILL ESCAPE YouTube channel!
Here's the link:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAJ4ttWsPTY
The first three levels of the game serve as a tutorial to help you master how to move the pill.
I realize that this requires precision and concentration, but I assure you that it's nothing you can't overcome!
After that, the adventure takes a less conceptual and more exploratory turn with increasingly vast levels (Starting in chapter two).
For level 2-4, I call it the static jump: only move your stick when the pill is in the air,
and release it before it touches the ground so it doesn't roll.
I hope you don't miss out on the remaining 98% of the game...

///////////
